SERVICE AGREEMENT — VERSION A (ORIGINAL)

This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of January 1, 2024, between:

TechCorp Solutions LLC ("Service Provider"), a Delaware limited liability company, and Retail Dynamics Inc. ("Client"), a New York corporation.

1. SERVICES

Service Provider agrees to provide software development and consulting services as described in Statement of Work No. 1, attached hereto and incorporated by reference.

Service Provider shall not subcontract any portion of the work without prior written consent of the Client.

2. PAYMENT TERMS

Client shall pay Service Provider a monthly retainer of $8,000 per month, payable within thirty (30) days of the first day of each month.

Late payments shall accrue interest at a rate of 1.5% per month.

3. TERM AND TERMINATION

This Agreement commences on January 1, 2024 and continues for a period of two (2) years unless earlier terminated.

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice.

Either party may terminate immediately for cause upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to cure such breach within fifteen (15) days of receiving written notice thereof.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

All work product, inventions, software, designs, and deliverables created by Service Provider in the performance of Services under this Agreement shall be the exclusive property of Client upon creation.

Service Provider retains a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use generalized methodologies and know-how developed during the engagement.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Neither party shall be liable to the other for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.

The total liability of either party under this Agreement shall not exceed one (1) times the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

6. INDEMNIFICATION

Each party shall indemnify and hold harmless the other party from claims arising from its own gross negligence or willful misconduct.

7. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement, together with all Statements of Work, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first set forth above.
